== BITwiki Phase 0 to Phase 1 Integration Master Document ==

'''Version:''' 1.0  
'''Date:''' 2026-02-09  
'''Status:''' Complete  
'''Scope:''' Integration of 36 research files across 6 domains into 34 book matter files

== Executive Summary ==

| Research Domain | Files | Primary Book Matter Category | Integration Priority |
|----------------|-------|------------------------------|---------------------|
| Grokpedia | 3 | Evidence-Epistemics | High |
| Wikipedia Systems | 5 | Front Matter / Ontology | High |
| Wolfram | 5 | Schema Matter | Critical |
| H+Pedia | 9 | Governance | High |
| RationalWiki | 5 | Governance / Evidence-Epistemics | Medium |
| Wiki Ecosystem | 9 | Constitutional / Schema Matter | Medium |
